source: AAA national average regular $4.29 on Sep 11 (up ~15c on the week from the $4.15 Labor Day record) as the crude spike finally filtered through to the pump; diesel hit a record $6.05-6.06 the same day (context only, not the regular-gas field). Up ~$1.30 / +43.5% vs the $2.99 pre-war baseline; the May 21 peak was $4.55. The Institute on Taxation and Economic Policy estimated the average added fuel cost per US household at $675.13 to date, forecast to reach $1,011.88 by end of autumn. State highs remain led by California, Hawaii and Washington; no state-level AAA breakdown re-collected this cycle - state premiums carried unchanged. Source: AAA / NBC / NPR / GasBuddy.
